So all three y reads must be free of subscript and explicit * and fold into one base: only (base + k)->y does. Direct lightAdd reads with p only before the lerps: 51 (the six p = reloads are load-bearing). variants.py scan of the 18 and 11 bodies: no zero.

new: f64 blend and rise locals splitting the lerp into two statements
